purpose: Determine source-first whether a DED foam can be embedded as a strict subfoam of a specific DLD foam with an added face eligible for j=0 trivial extension.
frozen_requirements: Extract exact DED and DLD source contexts and any source graph/figure environment defining their vertices, edges and faces.
Verify the refinement source defines subfoam/embedding and trivial extension using injective vertex, edge and face maps.
Counts or name similarity alone cannot establish an incidence-preserving embedding.
PASS to strict-refinement identification requires an explicit machine-reconstructible incidence map whose complement contains at least one face; otherwise classify source topology unresolved.
If source material only establishes the weaker two-vertex/edge/face count relation, classify candidate-qualified but embedding-unresolved.
claim_lock: No amplitude identity, cylindrical consistency, convergence or BRIDGE_DERIVED follows from source-topology qualification. No post-hoc incidence map may be invented from visual resemblance.
